summary: Brera Holdings PLC (d/b/a Solmate Infrastructure) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a letter to shareholders following its Annual General Meeting. The letter expresses gratitude for shareholder support, announces a search for additional independent directors, and outlines a strategic vision focused on building an institutional gateway to the Solana ecosystem from Abu Dhabi. There are no definitive deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event disclosed. The filing is a routine update from a foreign private issuer with no actionable corporate action, thus it does not constitute a special situation.
